title.en: Agents that keep your words intact.
title.fr: Des agents qui respectent vos mots.

introduction.en: Long messages, line breaks and approval prompts get more reliable.
introduction.fr: Les longs messages, les sauts de ligne et les demandes d’autorisation gagnent en fiabilité.

title.fr: Écrivez une fois. Gardez chaque ligne.

body.en: Agents insert long or multiline text in one go, without smart quotes or reordered lines. Lilo asks before an agent posts or replies.
body.fr: Les agents insèrent les longs textes en une fois, sans guillemets automatiques ni lignes désordonnées. Lilo demande votre accord avant toute publication ou réponse.

notes: AI agents can insert long or multi-line text in one go, and a long agent call keeps sending progress, so the agent's app does not give up on it.

AI agents now type text exactly as written, without your Mac's smart quotes or dashes, and Lilo asks you before an agent posts or replies on a site. A click from an agent also waits for the request it starts, so a post or payment is not cut off when the agent moves on.

Text an agent types with line breaks no longer lands out of order in editors such as X's, an agent's tab shown at a size the agent set no longer lets its other pages show around it, and an agent restarted through Claude Desktop keeps its tabs.
